Continuously expand your technical knowledge of SentinelOne products, operating systems, cybersecurity, and troubleshooting methodologies. What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring? Ideal candidates will have: Must-have: Previous technical support or customer-facing technical experience, on endpoint, cloud security or enterprise security products. Customer focus, desire to solve technical problems, ability to manage multiple customer issues while maintaining quality and urgency, and overall comfort working in a fast-moving technical environment. Proven analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, and ability to systematically investigate complex technical issues (including crash dumps) and clearly document findings. Excellent written and verbal communication, collaboration skills and willingness to learn from others. An advantage would be any of: scripting experience with PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar tool; experience troubleshooting endpoint or server environments; cybersecurity education, certifications, or professional experience. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.
